The night unfolded in true Faena fashion, immersive, energetic, and shaped by a shared appreciation for music and creative expression. Presented by Chase Sapphire, the Grand Opening After Party welcomed guests into a vibrant beginning to the week’s programming. item.title: Rubell Museum Exhibition Preview
item.description: Miami, FL - December 2, 2025 - A bold new chapter unfolds at the Rubell Museum as it debuts a sweeping slate of exhibitions for Miami Art Week 2025, headlined by its first-ever single-artist survey. item.title: POP MART Holiday Gift House at Aventura Mall
item.description: Miami, FL - December 2, 2025 - POP MART debuted its Holiday Gift House at Aventura Mall, drawing collectors and Labubu fans to its first-ever pop-up in the region. The limited-time shop opened on the mall’s lower level for a seven-week run, offering blind-box favorites like The Monsters, Skullpanda, Peach Riot, and a standout selection of festive, limited-edition Labubus. item.title: Art Basel Kickoff at Miami Ironside
item.description: Miami, FL - December 2, 2025 - Artist Jason Naylor and Veritable kicked off Art Week at Miami Ironside with a community-driven celebration centered on creativity and hands-on engagement. item.title: Opening Reception of David Castillo X Studio Lenca
item.description: Miami, FL - December 2, 2025 - David Castillo presented a solo exhibition of new paintings by Studio Lenca, the UK-based artist known for work rooted in personal narrative and cultural memory. Drawing from his own experiences, Studio Lenca explored themes of joy and belonging while challenging dominant cultural frameworks.
